up: Return the list of molecules reported in the document with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL3880421. Include the ChEMBL ID of the molecule (molecule_chembl_id) and its preferred name (pref_name).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3880421'
